_comment: Minimal config for the comparison-head alias. The compare head doesn't run a workflow, but vecoli_aws.sh's _use_variant reads experiment_id and emitter_arg.out_uri from the registered config to derive BUCKET/PREFIX. Bucket here just identifies WHERE to read v1/v2/mp/ray parquet from — same bucket the workflow runs use. All compare subcommands take --v1-id / --v2-id (or VECOLI_V1_ID / VECOLI_V2_ID env) for the experiment IDs to compare.
